corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Joint HMA/EMA NDSG institutional workplan with an extensive dedicated AI workstream for the European medicines regulatory network, including AI guidance, regulatory tools and research.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The cover issue is July 2025 at month precision. The 22 July catalogue last-update date is the document-specific hosted-revision publication fallback, not an established issue or adoption day. The first workplan's March adoption and 7 May first publication do not date this v1.4 manifestation. EMA's official catalogue links v1.4 as the previous version; v2.0 is the first annual revision. Earlier v1.0-v1.3 manifestations have not been recovered and no complete version history or canonical parent is invented. Future deliverables remain plans. Reviewer attribution denotes AI-assisted evidence review.
